body_md:
**Trade review, Tue 17 Nov: A quiet day: no fills, no targets, no exits; last night's LIQUID1 bug is fixed.**

Nothing bought, hit a target or closed today, so all 87 closed trades still total +172.0% (average +2.0%). Nifty rose 0.38% to 25,387.40. 15 trades are still running, 13 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 102 bought trades is +1.1%. Two new picks were listed (PARAGMILK and INDIANB). Tomorrow brings the 30-day exits of FINCABLES (−9.5%) and VMM (−3.1%), then AEGISLOG (−8.1%) on 20 Nov.

**Today's results**

No wins closed today. Plus 60 earlier, among them IDFCFIRSTB, NMDC, SUNDARMFIN, PFC and TMPV (11 Nov). These 70 wins (55 at T2, 15 partial) made +353.5%; with the 17 failures (−181.5% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 87 closed trades total +172.0%. 7 of the 15 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (6): GRANULES (12 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov), ASTRAL (4 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov), PNGSREVA and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 5 of these 6 are below their buy price (ASTRAL −9.5%, ESCORTS −8.6%, PNGSREVA −8.2%, ONGC −0.7%, LUPIN −0.4%).

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners still 19 of 31:** None new tonight. 23 of the 31 never bought came within 2% of the zone. CHENNPETRO is the latest near fill: 0.46% above the zone on its first day, and the zone+2% and next-open rules would both have bought it at ₹1,418.10 (now −0.5%).
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, a little more money:** Fills 94% vs 80% as listed: 14.0 points (the bar is 15). Its 104 closed trades made +201.7%, against +172.0% from 87 as listed, with 21 losing trades against 20.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.5% vs −7.8% as listed, 1.2 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 102 closed trades made +231.4% with 16 losing trades; average closed trade +2.6% against +2.0%.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −3.0% (closed and open), and their 24 closed trades net −68.6% with 11 of the 17 failures. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 14 retest near misses logged since then: 5 at T1, 4 at T2, best rise 3.7% on average. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** All 13 real failures came from stocks that rose 5% or more in the month before listing; the other 4 failures are flat liquid ETFs. Those 38 trades average −3.3% and their 32 closed trades net −106.4%; the other 64 made +278.4% from 55 closed trades, 42 at T2. Sixth review in a row, but it uses my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change yet. (holding)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 37 of 41 bought reached T1 (90%) and 30 reached T2 (73%); their 35 closed trades made +178.0% with 3 failures (CENTUM, WABAG and a flat LIQUIDBEES), and they dip least (−4.3%). (holding)
- **F&O stocks do far better than cash stocks:** 37 F&O trades: 28 at T2 (76%), worst dip −3.5%. 56 cash trades: 19 at T2 (34%), worst dip −11.4%. Back in the top 5 now that the room-filter lesson is gone. (new)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 19 of 31 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 23 of the 31 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys sit close to T1, so the wins are small, about +3.9% each. (holding)
- **Still true but out of the top 5:** picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (46 of 46). Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) fills less often (8 of 15, 53%) and those dip −9.4%.

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+231.4% vs +172.0%), but its dip gain is 1.2 points against a bar of 2; zone up to 2% above gets 14.0 points more fills against a bar of 15, the closest it has been. The run-up lesson is the strongest (13 of 13 real failures), but the 5% line is my own and the tracker has no group for the month-before return, so it stays a lesson.

**Bug check:** nothing new. Last night's LIQUID1 zone-bottom what-if is fixed: it is back to 'Failed' (+0.62%), and the zone-bottom row is back to 55 trades. 102 bought = 55 at T2 + 15 partial + 17 failed + 15 running; T1 hit 76 ≥ T2 hit 55; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no closed price, date or return changed. Nine closed T2 wins had their best rise raised slightly, which is expected: best rise keeps tracking until day 30.
